profile.headline: SW Engineer Manager at SAIC | Software Innovation | Agile Development | DevOps | Continuous Delivery | Automation
profile.summary:
Experienced Senior Director with a demonstrated history of working in the financial services industry, healthcare, transportation and packaging. Strong professional skilled in Project Management, DevOps, Development, Support, Agile Testing, Requirements Analysis, Agile Methodologies, and Test Automation.

I am a Software Development Leader focused on delivering value. Identifying the success criteria and key stakeholders and building a great enterprise wide team. Driving agility, process improvement, quality excellence, and DevOps automation into the software development and delivery lifecycle. Creation of ideas to build the business case for a new project. Tracking and reporting on the status of the project including budget, deliverables and growth of the team. Building a product that fulfills a user's needs and is easy to use and provides useful metrics/analytics back on areas for improvement.

Focuses on day to day steps to success as well as envisioning and planning for that next big project. A strategic thinker that can focus on the details for success. 

I am a successful relationship builder that is capable of securing the trust of leadership as well as development team members, project leaders, and the client, including serving as an evangelist for change and innovation, particularly in the areas of Agile, Lean, DevOps, Quality, and BDD.

Outside of work you will find me reading, enjoying time with family, and spending time on the lake.

positions.title: Software Engineer Manager
positions.description: Lead multiple DevSecOps teams to develop, deploy, support, and improve infrastructures for internal and external development teams. Tools include developer, test, security, and support tools. Working with vendors to get reseller agreements for licensed tools. Working on responses for proposals for estimates, tools and people needed to deliver the requested products.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Manager
positions.description: Build a team, processes and metrics to support a large project. Focusing on delivering value to the customer timely and with quality. Identifying areas for improvement.

positions.title: Senior Director Of Development and Operations
positions.description:
Built a full stack development teams to complete various features for new web applications deployed to the cloud.
Led a Legacy team that supported international products using DevOpsSec practices.
Transformation of Consumer products.

positions.title: Sr. Director of Quality
positions.description: Led Quality across a business unit. Included Legacy applications as well as new development.
